problem: Status labels ('on track / slipping') and small category tags: resolve('status label') returns UNDEFINED (closest guideline/hierarchy @ 4.0), resolve('category tag') returns UNDEFINED. Tag language lives in the Gate 2 sheet but not in the pack artifacts; achievement badges have no canon at all.
insufficiency: L-13 (docs/synthesis/leader/decisions.json; refs/sheet.html L-13 card, Gate 2) defines the mark precisely - 'Status = rectangular ink-outline tag, word inside (uppercase sans 11, 0.06em). Attention states turn the tag solid red with white word. No pills, no dots as sole signal' - but no pack entry carries it. Consumers invent pills/dots or squat on field/action styling for labels.
reuse_case: Statuses, categories and labels on any list or record UI; the demo used both a status form (on track / slipping) and category tags - a recurring labelled-mark class, not a one-off.
composition_check: Not composable: no entry provides a non-interactive labelled mark; action/field/notice are interactive/form/feedback vessels; colour tokens alone do not decide construction (outline weight, caps treatment, attention swap). Badges are not source-supported as a distinct object - an achievement badge composes from this tag + a rhythm glyph; no medal family should be invented.

proposed.title: Tag (status / category)
proposed.source_evidence: decisions.json L-13 (status tags); refs/sheet.html L-13 card; L-02 v4 (rounded surfaces, radius ~8); guideline/typography (sans caps register)

body.mark: rounded ~8 surface (per L-02 v4 and rule L-R1) with a 2px ink outline; uppercase sans 11, 0.06em tracking; strictly one line
body.attention: attention states turn the tag solid red with a white word; positive states keep the ink outline
body.rules: no pills, no dots as sole signal (L-13)
body.in_character: a stamped word, not a bubble; taxonomy stays quiet

tests: tag markup is not pill or full-round (radius check against the ~8 system radius)
attention state = solid red + white word; no dot-only status variant exists (spec check)
tag type is uppercase sans at <=11px with letter-spacing present (type check)
